diagnostics.message: references the WORKFLOW-SCOPED kind "conformance.workflow.anchor" from a parse-reachable position. A workflow-scoped kind is never advertised to the parser and never accepted from a parse, so a matcher gated on one can never hold and a selection anchored on one can never be minted — the workflow would be permanently unreachable. Use an ordinary capability here and invoke the scoped kind from an activity.
